title: Pinto Bean and Avocado Breakfast Tostadas
intro: Eating a combination of plant and egg protein in the morning helps maintain steady energy and lasting fullness until lunch.

ingredients.name: Raw pepitas
ingredients.canonical_name: Seeds, pumpkin and squash seed kernels, dried

ingredients.name: No-salt-added canned pinto beans
ingredients.canonical_name: Beans, pinto, canned, no salt added, drained

ingredients.name: Ground cumin
ingredients.canonical_name: Spices, cumin seed, crushed or ground

instructions: Place a large non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add the raw pepitas and toast for 2 to 3 minutes until golden and fragrant, then transfer to a small bowl.
Warm the corn tortillas in the same skillet over medium heat for 1 to 2 minutes per side until pliable and lightly toasted. Transfer to serving plates.

Add the extra-virgin olive oil, drained pinto beans, and ground cumin to the skillet over medium heat. Mash the beans roughly using a wooden spoon or silicone spatula for 3 to 4 minutes until warmed through, then divide evenly over the tortillas.
Add the baby spinach to the skillet and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until just wilted. Layer the spinach evenly over the mashed beans.

Whisk the whole eggs and egg whites together in a bowl. Pour into the skillet over medium-low heat and stir gently with a silicone spatula for 2 to 3 minutes until soft curds form and the eggs are set.
Spoon the scrambled eggs over the spinach. Top the tostadas evenly with the fresh pico de gallo, sliced avocado, and the toasted pepitas.
variation: Swap the baby spinach for thinly sliced fresh Tuscan kale.
conservation: Best enjoyed right away; does not keep well once assembled.

[chapter_intent_fit] The recipe overshoots the breakfast chapter's 55g carbohydrate ceiling, landing at 64g. Additionally, 3/4 cup of mashed beans per person is quite thick for just two small tortillas. Reduce the pinto beans from 1.5 cups (255g) to 1 cup (170g). This will improve the bean-to-tortilla ratio and bring the carbohydrates cleanly into the 45-55g target window.
